messages:
lumen_poc_contact: Quick heads-up: during the POC the Node EventSource polyfill intermittently fails parsing SSE — partial JSON then connection closes. Happens ~1-2x/min after a few KB.

lee_sales: Hosted or Dedicated? Region?

lumen_poc_contact: Hosted, eu-west-1. Client error: 'Unexpected end of JSON input'. No request-id in headers. Saw a couple 429s before disconnects.

omar_engineer: Can you paste a tiny curl capture and any proxy log lines?

lumen_poc_contact: curl shows 200 + chunked transfer, but body sometimes ends mid-event like: `data:{"msg":"partial text` then socket close. Proxy log snippet they provided:
```
[12:11:05] proxy: upstream_write() returned 0, client: 10.1.2.3
[12:11:06] proxy: 502 while reading upstream, client: 10.1.2.3
```

jade_infra: That looks like upstream closed. Quick mitigation: disable proxy_buffering for that route and bump proxy_read_timeout/send_timeout. I'll push a canary override for the org in eu-west.

nora_support: Also ask client to buffer until SSE event terminator ("\n\n") before JSON.parse and add reconnect/backoff on abrupt close. We'll share a small polyfill snippet.

[~4m later]

jade_infra: Canary applied: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout 180s; send_timeout 180s;` for lumen org in eu-west.

lumen_poc_contact: Retested immediately: 0/8 failures (was ~3/8). Running a 2h soak and will update.

omar_engineer: Follow-ups: (1) eng add X-Request-Id to SSE responses for traceability; (2) eng consider opt-in 15s heartbeat to avoid idle-proxy closes; (3) infra keep canary 48h and collect 502/5xx counts.

ticketbot: Created ticket SF-6002 to track SSE request-id + heartbeat work, linked to lumen POC.

lumen_poc_contact: Appreciate the quick help :thumbsup: — will report after soak.
